sentences.text: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day

**Scheme Brief Description:** Under this scheme, financial assistance, in form of subsidy, is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed mills, ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers.
**Who is this for:** Business Entity; Category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment; Sector: Fishing and hunting

**Detailed Description:** The “Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, aims to strengthen inland aquaculture infrastructure by promoting the establishment of small-scale fish feed mills. Under this scheme, financial assistance, in form of subsidy, is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed mills, ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers.

**Benefits / Assistance:** **Tangible Benefits:** - Project Cost: ₹30,00,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/ SC/ST/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number &amp; password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile. > **Login to Apply for the Scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list” and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on &quot;Submit&quot;. > **Track Your Service Online:** - **Track Application/Appeal:** [Click here](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/). - **Track Ticket:** [Click here](https://eticketing.saralharyana.nic.in/CitizenViewComplaints.aspx). > **Track Your Service Through SMS:** - **Registered Mobile Number:** Type SARAL and send to 9954699899 to track your application. - **Other Mobile Number:** Type SARAL&lt;space&gt;&lt;Application ID/Ticket No.&gt; and send to 9954699899 to track your application/ticket. > **Contact Us:** **Helpline:** 0172-3968400 **Email:** saral.haryana@gov.in &gt; **Fees For Service:** - Government Charges: ₹0 (No Fee) - Service Charges: ₹10 - Atal Seva Kendra Charges: ₹10 &gt; **Note:** - The applicant must submit certified invoices with GST compliance for all items purchased. Bills over ₹50,000 must comply with e-Way Bill, Income Tax, and GST rules. - The applicant must provide a CA (Chartered Accountant) certificate confirming tax-compliant payment of invoices.
**Additional Application Processes:** **Process 2:** The eligible applicant may visit the nearest Atal Seva Kendra with all the required documents to apply for the scheme.
**Tags:** Fish, Fish Farmer, Fish Production, Entrepreneur, Mini Fish Feed Mill
